classifier.rounds_rule: median best iteration over inner date-grouped folds with 100-round patience, at least 50

configuration.floor_rule: Raise every prediction to at least the minimum departure label of the fitting rows (refit months for the export).

mixture.applies_to: LIRF departures with no Network Manager record (AOBT_3_flt and LOBT_flt missing) and missing AIRCRAFT_TYPE_mvt whose schedule interval s = MVT_TIME_UTC_mvt - SCHED_TIME_UTC_mvt is at most 43200 seconds; every other row keeps the incumbent prediction, including the long-schedule rows above 43200 seconds whose one-day mode the incumbent already carries.
mixture.normal_component: median fitting label of normal-mode population rows within the schedule-interval band of the row
mixture.prediction: (1 - w) * incumbent + w * (p_fill * s + (1 - p_fill) * normal_component), with p_fill = P(fill) / (P(fill) + P(normal)) from the three-class classifier

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after a same-day diagnostic that found the stand-turnaround signal: among fitting-period population rows, the schedule-fill share is 65-83% when the scheduled departure precedes the previous arrival's in-block at the same stand and 25-33% when the schedule falls within two hours after it. A prototype three-class classifier with these features, evaluated on the original folds with fitting-month training, scored 318.076/317.218/317.385 seasonal and 219.927/219.757/219.879 forward for mixture weights 0.5/0.75/1.0 against v7's 322.819/221.138. The declared implementation fixes the feature definitions, date-grouped inner validation, seed and bands; its scores are recomputed from scratch here. The v8 result (283.668) is not used for any rule: rows above 43200 seconds are left exactly at v7.
configuration.selection: Score the three fixed candidates on both complete original folds against the exactly reconstructed v7 development predictions. Require at least 0.5% lower complete RMSE than v7 on EACH fold, then choose the lowest equally weighted mean ratio; otherwise select nothing. The classifier and normal component are fitted on the fold's fitting months only; no scoring, stopping, December or ranking labels enter any parameter. Common weights at all rows; no airport, threshold or band search.

turnaround_features.description: Label-free stand occupancy from arrival rows at LIRF: the latest arrival in-block at the departure's stand that is at least 1200 seconds before takeoff (previous aircraft), and the first arrival in-block after that point (next aircraft). Features: schedule minus previous in-block, takeoff minus previous in-block, next in-block minus takeoff. Arrival in-block times remain supplied in the ranking data.
